findings.title: Add the ColBERT singleton locking contract before concurrent slots are enabled
findings.original_premise: `refresh_model_dir()` can clear shared ONNX/tokenizer globals while `ensure_loaded()` or `encode()` uses them, creating a transient empty session and ordinary miss.
findings.revised_deliverable: Define one narrow lock around model-dir repoint, lazy load, and each encode critical section; use deterministic fake tokenizer/session barriers to prove calls see either the old complete slot or the new complete slot, never a partial reset. Do not start reranker or claim deployed concurrency behavior.

toolkit_reuse.what: Existing global state seams; no new decision toolkit needed.

source_evidence.observation: Refresh clears module-level session/tokenizer and loader repopulates them without a lock; task premise matches current source.
Task explicitly places locking before concurrent KB-RAG/reranker enablement.

findings.non_inference_scope: Lock contract and fake-object interleaving tests only.
findings.inference_acceptance: No performance or concurrency deployment claim; live concurrent enablement remains owner-gated.
findings.gate: Before any concurrent reranker enablement; coordinate before touching shared retrieval module.
findings.proposed_handoff_append: **Source verification (JEV audit, 2026-10-06):** `refresh_model_dir()` clears `_session`/`_tokenizer` and `ensure_loaded()` repopulates the globals without synchronization. Before any concurrent KB-RAG/reranker enablement, define a narrow lock contract covering refresh/load/encode and test deterministic fake-object interleavings. This is local state integrity only; no reranker activation or runtime performance claim.
